cause: After trimming the beginning, the clip reflows toward the viewport origin, leaving too little pointer travel to recover all hidden source frames.
changes: Holding an intentionally dragged trim handle near the viewport edge continues extending or shortening the source range.
No extension begins from a stationary press or an interior pointer.
Continuation is frame bounded and discards overshoot at source limits.
Pointer release applies its final position; cancel, blur, hidden tab and capture loss stop continuation.
Focus preserves scroll position and gestures are bound to the initiating pointer.
Timeline help explains edge holds and Home/End source-boundary shortcuts.

automatedCoverage: recover hidden leading and trailing source frames
validation.nativeInteractionReview: Uploaded-video start handle was verified at zero in Chrome; additional Clip editor edge-hold behavior was checked by automated tests and code review.
